notes: OUTSIDE half of the Lumen Siphon (neon, 4x2): a funnel of navy panels crowned with crystal spikes, a cyan vortex of dashed rings spiralling into a faceted crystal core at the throat. Pull radius 6 cells, small debris only. pulling: the vortex turns and the core flares, with a wide cyan glow and shimmer arcs (glow layer). damaged: a spike snapped and hanging, the collar cracked, the vortex stuttering; disabled: scorched, dull, dented, sparking.
